source.method: MLCommons-run peer-reviewed benchmark. Submitters tune a fixed model and dataset. Server and Interactive scenarios report the highest Poisson query rate whose 99th-percentile TTFT and TPOT meet the benchmark bound; Offline reports unconstrained throughput. Single-turn prompts, no agent traces, no prefix reuse stated.
